On Nov 19, 2014, at 5:27 PM, Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:
Writing about the Rule 5 deadline for tomorrow's paper. Is Joel Hanrahan eligible for the Rule 5 draft if he is not placed on the 40-man? And is there a time deadline (i.e. 5 p.m.) for this?
Also, did you guys have a person at Yoan Moncada's showcase event in Guatemala last week?
